properties.obligation: Constructor stores the exact configuration and rejects zero receiver, zero duration, duration above int256.max, and either fee above 10000.
properties.domain: Constructor syntheticToken may be zero and graphSize is unused. Test the implemented guards, then report absent configuration guards.

properties.obligation: Each admin method rejects a non-admin with unchanged state, and the admin succeeds with valid arguments.
properties.domain: Use a distinct nonzero sender and valid arguments. Assert the custom selector on rejection, avoiding unrelated reverts.

properties.obligation: Only the nonzero pending admin can accept. Acceptance replaces admin, clears pendingAdmin, and revokes the prior admin.
Accept exactly cap <= int256.max and store it. Characterize that the setter permits a cap below totalActiveLocked.
properties.domain: Boundary partitions include 0, int256.max, and values above int256.max.
properties.notes: Interface ITransmuter.sol:97 says cap must exceed current locked amount. The implementation lacks this check.

properties.obligation: Both fee setters enforce inclusive 0..10000 bounds. Changing a fee affects later claims but not position principal.
properties.domain: Fee=10000 is legal, so assert fee <= amount rather than the catalog strict fee < amount.

properties.obligation: Duration remains positive and <= int256.max. Existing positions retain their start and maturation blocks after an update.
properties.domain: Graph accepts only block endpoints below 2^32-1. Duration setter bounds are broader than executable deposit bounds.

properties.obligation: Admin can set any nonzero fee receiver. A zero receiver reverts and preserves the prior receiver.
The getter returns the stored principal and original block interval. Unknown and deleted positions return zero fields.
properties.domain: Fixture includes real create and claim calls, plus an unused ID.

properties.obligation: The URI encodes the requested token ID and the Transmuter title, with bounded output and valid Base64 JSON/SVG.
properties.domain: Use uint256 ID boundaries and representative titles.
properties.notes: tokenURI currently does not check ownership or existence, unlike default ERC721.tokenURI. This is an observable behavior, not a fund safety claim.

properties.obligation: Create rejects zero deposit, zero recipient, active-cap overflow, and totalLocked exceeding totalSyntheticsIssued. Rejections preserve tokens, NFTs, totals, and graph.
properties.domain: Use bounded concrete block/duration fixtures with valid ERC20 and Alchemist dependencies. Split each rejection from the successful path.
properties.notes: Inherits StakingGraph loops. A reverting arithmetic expression must not count as proof of successful-case safety.

properties.obligation: A successful deposit transfers exactly principal, mints one NFT to recipient, stores the interval, and increments each total once.
properties.domain: Symbolic amount 1..1e27 is an explicit scenario range, not a supply limit. Concrete starts/durations selected around tree growth boundaries.
properties.notes: Token transfer is assumed exact and non-reentrant. Test malicious callbacks separately. Graph rate can truncate to zero for very small amount/duration ratios.

properties.obligation: Exercise signed conversion, amount*1e8, graph packed bounds, and maturation arithmetic through the real deposit function.
properties.domain: Include int256.max/1e8, signed 112-bit rate boundaries, and start+duration near 2^32-1. Separate expected-revert partitions.
properties.notes: A safe rejection is distinct from liveness throughout the admin-accepted configuration domain.

properties.obligation: Only the current NFT owner can claim after the creation block. Missing, burned, and same-block positions reject with no state changes.
properties.domain: Use valid arithmetic and backing fixtures so owner rejection cannot be masked. Cover NFT transfer and approved-but-not-owner callers.
properties.notes: Early claim before maturity is legal, contrary to ITransmuter.sol:155. The implemented gate blocks only the creation block.

properties.obligation: For an actual position and current block >= start, untransmuted = ceil(amount*blocksLeft/duration) lies within amount. Matured positions have zero untransmuted.
properties.technique: T10 exact ceil helper and T6 floor/remainder identity
properties.domain: amount <=1e27, duration <=2^32, blocksLeft<=duration gives product <=~4.3e36. Include amount=0 in a separate model branch.
properties.evidence_target: bounded arithmetic model plus implementation correspondence test
properties.notes: Model lemma only. Pair with actual FixedPointMath and Transmuter tests. Use ceil via quotient plus nonzero remainder, preserving rounding.

properties.obligation: Backing denominator is positive. Ceil debt ratio never understates debt/backing, and bad-debt scaling cannot exceed amountTransmuted.
properties.technique: T9 concrete decimals and T10 ceil helper
properties.domain: Enumerate decimals 0,6,8,12,18 for meaningful supported deployments plus 77/78/255 rejection edges. These are not an exhaustive uint8 domain.
properties.evidence_target: bounded arithmetic model plus implementation correspondence test
properties.notes: Token decimals lack a local upper bound. A production restriction must come from the actual Alchemist/deployment. Source default amount range 1e27 is explicit analysis scope.

properties.obligation: claimYield+feeYield equals distributable <= sharesAvailable. syntheticReturned+syntheticFee+burn equals principal. Each fee is bounded by its own base.
properties.technique: T4 branch partition and T14 conservation
properties.domain: fees 0..10000, amount/shares <=1e27. Partition early/mature, bad debt/no bad debt, repayment shortfall/no shortfall.
properties.evidence_target: bounded arithmetic model plus implementation correspondence test
properties.notes: Do not assert all synthetics burn on bad debt. The haircutted transmuted principal can burn despite no yield payment.

properties.obligation: Actual claim transfers the four return amounts, burns exactly the remaining synths, reduces issued supply by the burn, sets the final MYT balance, and deletes the NFT/position.
properties.domain: Real Transmuter bytecode with faithful dependency mocks first, then real Alchemist integration. Include zero payout, complete haircut, shortfall, rounding dust and repeat claims.
properties.notes: Mocks prove only Transmuter behavior under declared responses. Full integration must reuse actual Alchemist and token adapter.

properties.obligation: Claim lowers totalLocked once. Active total decreases once, either on poke or claim. Matured poke is permissionless and cannot double-decrement.
properties.domain: Successful positions with and without poke, multiple positions, transfer before claim, repeated poke/claim.

properties.obligation: Explore callback sequences during synthetic transferFrom, yield transfer, burn and Alchemist calls for duplicate principal or accounting desynchronization.
properties.domain: Malicious dependency harness, bounded 1-2 callbacks and 2 positions.
properties.notes: No local nonReentrant guard. Trusted-token assumption limits ordinary proofs. Reentrancy safety requires real callback execution and is not established by NFT burn alone.

properties.obligation: queryGraph returns the ceil of nonnegative graph stake /1e8, returns zero for reversed intervals, and follows graph block bounds.
properties.technique: T9 bounded timelines with real graph harness
properties.domain: Concrete representative graph timelines and symbolic rate/principal; include start=0, end=2^32, and empty graph.
properties.notes: queryStake rejects start=0. Bound results against sum of per-position rate contributions, not original principal without rounding loss.

properties.obligation: Constructor rejects any zero dependency and stores each supplied nonzero address.
Vote rejects mismatched/empty arrays and preserves aggregate weight when a same-balance user replaces a vote. Expiry branches follow 30-day and 365-day rules.
properties.domain: Enumerate 1-3 strategy entries, bounded power/weights and timestamps avoiding arithmetic overflow. Include duplicate strategy IDs.
properties.notes: A model is not enough. Run actual vote bytecode and inspect aggregate via a read-only harness or storage layout.

properties.obligation: After a voting-token balance change, replacing or clearing a vote should not underflow or leave a prior contribution in aggregate weight.
properties.domain: One strategy, initial power 1..1e18, power increase/decrease/zero, active and expired prior vote.
properties.notes: Source-only suspected failure: subtraction uses current power instead of power at the original vote. Expired votes also skip removal in vote.

properties.obligation: With unchanged power, clear removes exactly stored contributions and deletes the vote. Repeated clear rejects.
properties.domain: 1-3 strategy entries and bounded weights. Voter registry is not cleared, so verify it does not create duplicate entries on next vote.

properties.obligation: Characterize who can reset lastStrategyAddedAt and whether registration creates a reachable allocation entry.
properties.domain: Arbitrary sender and strategyId.
properties.notes: Source-only incomplete implementation: permissionless register only sets timestamp. strategyList is never populated.

properties.obligation: For a seeded valid strategyList, outputs preserve IDs and sum(normalizedWeights)<=1e18 with rounding deficit < n. Zero total yields all zero weights.
properties.domain: Enumerate list lengths 0..3 and positive aggregate bounds.
properties.notes: Nonempty strategyList requires a storage-seeded harness. Label as synthetic state, not reachable production state. Expiration is not checked in this function.

properties.obligation: Actual allocation respects individual and per-risk global WAD caps and never exceeds idle assets. Allocation calls receive the expected target and strategy ID.
properties.domain: Seed 1-3 strategies only in a disclosed synthetic state. Also prove fresh deployment always rejects No allocations.
properties.notes: Source-only expected mismatches: /1e4 instead of classifier WAD /1e18, one totalRiskAllocated for all positive risks, caller supplies totalIdleAssets, no caller guard. Production allocator may provide downstream guards.

properties.obligation: Exercise bounded many-voter histories, balances, expiry changes, duplicate IDs and multiple risk classes through actual bytecode.
properties.domain: 1-5 voters,1-8 strategies,1-20 operations. Include extreme-weight arithmetic rejection.
properties.notes: Unbounded lists and unrestricted histories remain unverified.

properties.obligation: Encoding multiplies by 1e18 without loss in the valid range. Rational equals floor(n*1e18/d) and rejects zero d or encoding overflow.
properties.technique: Library bytecode harness with T6 remainder identities
properties.domain: n<=uint256.max/1e18, d>0. Partition boundary rejection from successful calls.

properties.obligation: Each overload equals exact checked addition/subtraction after scalar conversion and rejects overflow/underflow without wrap.
properties.domain: Encode scalar operand before comparing. Cover both Number and uint256 overloads.

properties.obligation: Simple multiplication/division matches exact bounded integer arithmetic with stated floor rounding and checked overflow.
properties.domain: For Number*Number restrict product to uint256. Use independent quotient/remainder inequalities rather than an identical expression oracle.

properties.obligation: Comparison returns exactly -1,0,1 by operand order, equals agrees with cmp==0, and max returns uint256.max.
properties.domain: Full operand bit widths are tractable for comparison.

properties.obligation: Actual mulDiv and mulDivUp match floor/ceil integer product division where product fits 256 bits. Each rejects denominator zero.
properties.technique: T4 bounded actual-bytecode equivalence plus T10 model
properties.domain: Partition denominator zero, exact quotient, nonzero remainder, zero operands. Bound symbolic operands by 1e27 initially.
properties.notes: This tests the local custom implementation, not OpenZeppelin. The model helper alone cannot establish this property.

properties.obligation: Full-width implementation matches an independent wide-precision oracle and rejects quotient overflow, including ceil overflow at uint256.max.
properties.domain: Target prod1==0, prod1>0, denominator<=prod1, powers of two/odd denominators and nonzero remainders.
properties.notes: Reference can be OpenZeppelin Math.mulDiv with independently reviewed rounding or precomputed arbitrary-precision vectors. Fuzz agreement is not formal equivalence.

properties.obligation: For domain a<=uint256.max,b<=2^128, mulQ128 equals ceil(a*b/2^128) and never wraps. Identity b=2^128 and zero operands hold.
properties.technique: T4 actual-bytecode domain partitions and T17 full-width fuzz
properties.domain: Propagate the ratio <=2^128 precondition to every Alchemist caller. Use bounded symbolic small, exact-boundary and wide-product fuzz partitions.
properties.notes: Outside the ratio domain, high quotient bits can truncate and ceil can wrap because there is no explicit overflow guard.

properties.obligation: For 0<=numer<=2^128 and denom>=numer>0, divQ128 equals floor(numer*2^128/denom), returns at most 2^128, and handles numer=2^128.
properties.technique: T4 exact fast/boundary paths with actual bytecode
properties.domain: Split numer=0,0<numer<2^128,numer=2^128,denom=0.
properties.notes: Zero numerator returns zero even with zero denom. Outside numer<=2^128, remainder shift can lose high bits. Caller-domain proof is required.

properties.obligation: Real graph query equals the sum of amount times the overlap of each scheduled interval with inclusive query blocks. Tree expansion preserves existing results.
properties.technique: T9 bounded timelines and real storage harness
properties.domain: Enumerate small starts/durations around 1,2,4,8,16 tree boundaries. Symbolic signed amounts within 112-bit packed bounds.
properties.notes: Derive the exact first accrual block from code: change at start affects cumulative blocks start+1 through start+duration. Test cancellations and after-expiration queries.

properties.obligation: Packed signed delta/product round-trip exactly and node updates reject out-of-range sums without corrupting neighboring packed fields.
properties.evidence_target: pack model plus real-bytecode storage traces
properties.notes: Pure pack lemmas do not prove update storage behavior. Pair each pack partition with real add/query storage traces.

properties.obligation: Graph bounds reject invalid blocks/rates and handle maximum valid start/expiration/query edges without wrap or infinite iteration.
properties.technique: T4 branch partitions and T17 adversarial fuzz
properties.domain: GRAPH_MAX=2^32. add start and expiration <2^32-1. query start>=1, end<=2^32.
properties.notes: Unchecked start+duration can wrap for unconstrained uint256 duration. Test wrapped duration explicitly. Transmuter duration<=int256.max prevents wrap with valid start, but library is broader.

properties.obligation: Random reachable add/cancel sequences match an independent interval model across tree growth, sign changes, and packed extrema.
properties.domain: Bound operations and timeline explicitly. Derive cancellations from existing intervals.
properties.notes: Full 32-bit symbolic loops and unbounded history are not proved. Finite Halmos loop unrolling must reject incomplete exploration.

properties.notes: TokenUtils requires token.code.length>0. Local SafeERC20 writes accept empty success from an EOA. Report this as a source behavior unless a production caller can select it.

properties.obligation: Add inserts an absent address exactly once and contains reflects membership. Duplicate addition returns false without mutation.
properties.domain: Include zero address and symbolic alias/distinct addresses.

properties.obligation: Remove preserves membership/index bijection, updates a moved last element, and leaves state unchanged when absent.
properties.domain: Enumerate empty/singleton/two/three-element histories, first/middle/last removal and repeated removal.

properties.obligation: Constructor sets owner to deployer and starts enabled with no entries.
Only the current owner can add, remove, or disable. Ownership transfer changes the authorized caller.
properties.domain: Valid enable-state arguments isolate authorization failure. Inherited OpenZeppelin transfer/renounce behavior is an external dependency.

properties.obligation: Disable is irreversible, makes every account whitelisted, and blocks further add/remove or repeated disable.
properties.domain: Use successful disable followed by each real method, not an assumed disabled flag.

properties.obligation: Returned addresses match set membership after duplicate add and swap-pop removal. Enabled isWhitelisted returns membership exactly.
properties.domain: 0..3 entries and symbolic address equality partitions.

properties.obligation: Constructor rejects zero admin/operator and grants exactly the supplied operator.
Only admin can alter pending admin, operator status, or the selector allowlist. Valid admin calls store exact values.
Only pending admin accepts, acceptance clears pending state, and former admin loses control.
properties.domain: Real transaction senders are nonzero. Pending zero cancels the transfer. Avoid impossible msg.sender=zero vacuity.

properties.obligation: Only nonzero operators can be assigned, and revocation prevents subsequent proxy calls.
Only an operator with an allowed first four calldata bytes can forward. The target receives exact calldata/value and failed targets revert atomically.
properties.technique: T9 byte-length partitions with target recorder
properties.domain: Enumerate calldata lengths 0..4 and representative longer payloads. Symbolic selector/address/value within funded amounts.
properties.notes: Assembly selector extraction is byte-level, not nonlinear math. Enumerate calldata shape and execute real assembly. Any vault address is allowed.

properties.obligation: Constructor produces zero supply, empty roles, and fixed name/symbol metadata.
properties.domain: File header identifies this as the invariant-testing version.

properties.obligation: Only whitelisted unpaused callers mint. A mint increases supply, recipient balance, and hasMinted by the amount atomically.
properties.domain: Bound mint amounts/sums for success and test checked-overflow rejection separately.
properties.notes: There is no mint ceiling enforcement. Include a concrete characterization test with amount>ceiling rather than claiming TOK-3 passes.

properties.obligation: Characterize that every caller can change whitelist, pause state, and ceilings, and a caller can self-whitelist then mint.
properties.domain: No admin role exists in the implementation despite comments/constants.
properties.notes: Expected test-fixture behavior. Must not silently assume production access controls.

properties.obligation: Burn reduces caller balance and supply equally, leaves hasMinted unchanged, and rejects insufficient balance.
burnFrom consumes exact allowance and balance while reducing supply, and insufficient allowance/balance reverts atomically.
properties.domain: Unlike standard infinite-allowance ERC20 handling, this function subtracts from uint256.max allowance.

properties.obligation: Only a whitelisted caller reduces its own hasMinted by min(amount,hasMinted), without changing supply or balances.
The SVG includes the exact decimal token ID without truncation, splits at 25 characters, and preserves fixed logo content.
properties.technique: T17 actual code with decoded output assertions
properties.domain: uint256 has at most 78 digits plus #, so at most four lines. Include 0 and uint256.max.
properties.notes: Inner text loop reaches 25 and Strings/Base64 contain loops/assembly. Metadata does not secure custody.

properties.obligation: The Base64 URI decodes into valid expected JSON with embedded SVG, and round-trip preserves the ID and image.
properties.domain: Real callers pass fixed safe titles. Arbitrary titles can contain markup; do not claim arbitrary string escaping.

properties.obligation: Inputs below four bytes return false at the external entry. Unsupported function selectors reject. Accepted selector branches dispatch to the expected decoder.
properties.domain: Enumerate the two accepted selectors, unknown selector, lengths 0..4, and malformed ABI cases.

properties.obligation: Slice preserves exactly the requested bytes and rejects out-of-bounds intervals or start beyond length.
properties.domain: Bound bytes length to 0..8 for symbolic tests. Fuzz longer action payloads.

properties.obligation: Each accepted action selector checks the intended token. Empty/malformed/unsupported actions and invalid ABI fail as specified.
properties.technique: T4 selector partitions and T9 list lengths
properties.domain: Enumerate six supported action types, native deposit rejection and unknown selector. Bound actions to 0..3 and disclose loop limits.
properties.notes: No checks bind saa.recipient, saa.buyToken, saa.minAmountOut or owner. Empty actions pass. Source behavior cannot establish end-to-end slippage.

properties.obligation: Token mismatch or bps>maxSlippageBps rejects. Valid bounded fields follow the declared encoding.
properties.domain: Concrete ABI layout with symbolic token/bps, exact threshold and threshold+1.
properties.notes: Whether action bps actually means slippage needs current official 0x ABI/semantic validation. Do not assume it does.

properties.obligation: Characterize accepted token-matching actions with arbitrary amount, owner/from and recipient fields.
properties.domain: Concrete well-formed action per branch with adversarial owner/recipient/amount.
properties.notes: Code explicitly removed balance checks and ignores these fields. A security property that the verifier bounds them should be expected to fail.

properties.obligation: Parser accepts only enough bytes and decodes the first address/amount words exactly. Boundary malformed data rejects.
properties.domain: Lengths 0,31,32,63,64,65. Fuzz malformed ABI address high bits.
properties.notes: Both parsers are explicitly simplified TODO implementations. Actual 0x format compatibility remains unverified.

properties.obligation: Exercise arbitrary bounded calldata, nested offsets, truncation, large lengths, supported selectors, and mutation of valid encodings.
properties.domain: Payload lengths 0..2048, actions 0..8, deterministic malformed samples.
properties.notes: Do not replace raw calldata with only valid encodings. Accepted output is not proof of actual swap correctness.

properties.obligation: After each completed real transaction, both fees are <=10000, duration>0, totalLocked<=issued, totalActiveLocked<=totalLocked, and synthetic balance>=totalLocked.
properties.technique: T4 reachable transition partitions plus bounded multi-contract histories
properties.domain: Real reachable states with 1-2 positions and standard exact-transfer synthetic token. Check empty state, deposits, early/mature claims, poke, admin updates and supply changes.

inherited_surface: Transmuter ERC721/ERC721Enumerable transfer/approval/owner enumeration must participate in ownership/claim integration tests. Dependency code is not re-certified by these local tests.
Whitelist Ownable transferOwnership/renounceOwnership must participate in permission tests.
AlEth inherits ERC20 transfer/transferFrom/approve and metadata getters. Cover balance changes used by gauge and supply invariants.
trust_assumptions: Transmuter standard flow assumes exact-transfer, non-rebasing, non-reentrant synthetic and yield tokens. Explicit callback cases are a separate obligation.
Alchemist mock responses must state conversion formulas, backing units, returned shares, supply updates, and redeem transfer effects. Mock proofs do not prove the real Alchemist.
Admin can replace Alchemist with any address and set fees up to 100%. A benign admin configuration is an explicit economic assumption, not access-control proof.
Token decimal compatibility and valid runtime exponent must be derived from the concrete deployment. Transmuter does not locally restrict uint8 decimals.
FixedPointMath.mulQ128 requires ratio-domain restrictions to avoid high-bit truncation. divQ128 assumes numer<=2^128 for its stated exactness domain.
StakingGraph user histories must retain valid packed sums and nonnegative aggregate scheduled stake. Arbitrary storage is not a reachable-state assumption.
IStrategyClassifier caps are WAD, not basis points. The production allocator may independently restrict authority and cap total allocation.
PermissionedProxy trusts authorized operators to choose target/arguments for allowed selectors. The selector allowlist does not restrict vault address.
OpenZeppelin dependencies remain external implementation dependencies unless included in bytecode path assertions.
ZeroX action selector constants and ABI semantics need independent official source validation before any actual swap safety claim.
AlEth is an explicitly modified invariant-test token. Its public controls are not evidence about a deployed production synthetic token.

source_observations_not_verified_finding.observation: Removal uses current token balance, so changed balance can cause underflow or stale aggregate weight. Need executable counterexample.
Expired prior contributions persist. Registration does not populate strategyList. Nonempty allocations are unreachable from fresh public state.
Gauge uses /1e4 for WAD classifier caps and one aggregate across all positive risk classes. Nonempty state requires a disclosed synthetic harness.
Invariant-testing token allows anyone to whitelist/pause/set ceiling and never enforces ceiling on mint.
Recipient/output/minimum-out/owner fields lack checks and two parsers are simplified placeholders. No production source importer found.
Unlike TokenUtils, write wrappers accept empty-success EOA calls. Production relevance depends on MYTStrategy target configuration.
Unchecked start+duration could wrap for standalone arbitrary duration. Transmuter duration bound plus valid start prevents that wrap.
Q128 helpers are partial-domain routines. Out-of-domain inputs can truncate rather than reject.
Admin-accepted cap/time ranges exceed graph/int multiplication liveness ranges. Prove explicit rejection behavior and bounded successful domain.

limitations: No tests, solver runs, compilation, or repository writes occurred in this task. All entries are planned obligations.
Parent already confirmed graft CLI and graft/INDEX.md absent. This analysis used source reads and rg as the fallback.
Do not report a pure guard comparison, assumed range, assert(true), zero explored paths, or all-reverting run as an implementation proof.
The skill CROSSMUL examples are not integer equivalences. For positive denominators use proven sufficient directions or q*d<=n<(q+1)*d with overflow-safe products.
One symbolic path can still represent many inputs. Inspect path conditions and successful witnesses instead of treating path count alone as a vacuity verdict.
For every rejected operation, check the intended error or pair with a valid positive witness so unrelated failure cannot satisfy the property.
Abstract ceil/floor/packing lemmas require separate actual-bytecode correspondence checks. State mutations and external effects cannot follow from copied formulas alone.
Enumeration is bounded coverage unless the enumerated set exhausts the actual valid domain. Decimal examples are not exhaustive uint8 verification.
Unbounded graphs, voter arrays, callback recursion, histories and dynamic bytes remain outside finite Halmos bounds unless separately proved.
Fuzz wrappers must avoid skipped/returned cases counting as useful coverage. Construct satisfying domains and record successful assertion counts where feasible.
Private graph packing helpers are only observable through a real harness or source-preserving exposure. Label any copied model distinctly.
Solidity library functions can remain pure despite assembly. Compiler mutability is authoritative over the skill blanket claim that assembly requires view.
